b1-unit-39.39.1 Two phone calls:
Narrator: Call one. Monday evening.
Ana: Hello?
Danny: Hi Ana! It's Danny. Is this a good time?
Ana: Sure! I'm on my break. How are things?
Danny: Pretty good! Listen... my birthday is on Thursday, and I'm having a small get-together at the hostel this weekend. Would you like to come?
Ana: Oh, happy birthday in advance! I'd love to come. When is it?
Danny: Shall we say Saturday evening?
Ana: I'm afraid Saturday isn't good for me. I'll be working a twelve-hour shift at the hospital. Can you make it on Friday instead?
Danny: Friday... yeah, Friday sounds fine. Bruno is going to Porto Alegre on Saturday morning, so Friday works for him too. And Mrs. Lima says we can use the kitchen.
Ana: Great! What time?
Danny: How about eight? I'll be cooking all afternoon, so come hungry!
Ana: Perfect. See you on Friday!
Narrator: Call two. Thursday afternoon.
Danny: Hello?
Ana: Hi Danny! It's Ana. Happy birthday! Listen, I'm calling about tomorrow. I'm really sorry, but something has come up. A colleague is sick, so I'll be covering her night shift.
Danny: Oh no, that's a pity.
Ana: I know. Can we put it off till Sunday?
Danny: Sunday works for me. But Bruno will be flying back from Porto Alegre on Sunday afternoon. His plane lands at six.
Ana: Then let's say seven thirty. Is that OK?
Danny: Sure! Seven thirty at the hostel.
Ana: And I'll pick up a cake on my way. I know a great bakery near the hospital.
Danny: You don't have to do that!
Ana: I want to. It's your birthday! So... are we still on for Sunday?
Danny: Definitely. See you then!

Narrator: I'll be working all day on Saturday.
Narrator: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Porto Alegre.
Narrator: I'll be cooking, so come hungry!
Narrator: Will you be using the car tonight?
Narrator: She won't be coming to the party.
Narrator: Don't call at nine. We'll be having dinner.
